announcement.title: Claude Opus 5.5 and automatic provider updates
announcement.description: Update Halofy Workstation and its host server to add Claude Opus 5.5 to the model picker. Opus 5.5 requires Claude Code 2.1.280 or newer and an account with model access. Supported provider CLI updates now install automatically; review progress in Settings → Providers or turn automatic installation off in Settings → General. Package-manager version pins, release channels and installation-source delays still apply. This release includes an unsigned Windows installer; macOS installers remain signed and notarized.
